rationale: Alito, as the most senior justice in the majority, holds the assignment power and is likely to either write the opinion himself or assign it to Gorsuch given their shared textualist methodology and the need to hold a coalition spanning Sotomayor and Jackson. The ideologically diverse majority (spanning Alito/Gorsuch on one end and Sotomayor/Jackson on the other) makes separate concurrences highly probable, particularly from Sotomayor or Jackson emphasizing consequentialist concerns and from Thomas in dissent stressing structural uniformity.
